description: Election Commission - A Member of the Negombo Urban Council Divulapitiya PS, Meerigama PS, Minuwangoda PS et.c.
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various local government bodies due to ceasing membership in political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it involves the administration of local authority elections and the declaration of vacancies in elected positions.
